task.title: Thanksgiving-week holiday hours rollout, Pacific stores
task.objective: Publish Thanksgiving-week holiday hours (closed Thursday, 6am-10pm Friday, normal hours otherwise) for the Pacific stores, then notify each store's manager once. Boise (BOI) is held until the user confirms. Spokane (GEG) depends on overtime approval AR-30918 for employee E-4471.
task.outcome: Holiday hours are published and each manager has been notified exactly once at PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM. The Spokane schedule is published only after AR-30918 is approved. BOI is handled only as the user directs.

success_criteria.description: Holiday hours published at PDX, SEA, TAC, EUG, SLE, BND, OLM, and at GEG under an approved AR-30918.
Each of the eight non-Boise managers has been notified exactly once.
No Spokane schedule that puts E-4471 into overtime is published before AR-30918 is approved.
BOI is left untouched until the user confirms.

includes: PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND, OLM holiday hours and manager notices
Overtime approval AR-30918 for E-4471 at GEG
excludes: Any change at Boise (BOI) until the user confirms

completed.description: Listed stores. All nine Pacific stores showed holiday_hours 'not published'.
Requested overtime approval for E-4471 at GEG. It was created as AR-30918 with status pending.
publish_holiday_hours succeeded for PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM. GEG was published while AR-30918 was still pending (see q-geg-schedule).
Sent manager notices to PDX, SEA and TAC. Do not resend them.

focus.description: Sending manager notices. The store-operations backend connection dropped starting with the GEG notice. All later calls, including two get_approval checks of AR-30918, returned 'session has ended (connection to the backend lost). No action was taken.'

next.description: Tell the user that publish_holiday_hours ran for GEG while AR-30918 was pending. The prior assistant's summary told the user the Spokane schedule had not been published, which may be inaccurate. Ask whether the GEG publish counts as the Spokane schedule under the overtime policy, and what to do about it.
Once the backend is reachable, send the manager notices for EUG, SLE, BND and OLM, one each.
Check AR-30918 with get_approval in the system of record.
Handle GEG according to the user's answer and AR-30918's status, then send the GEG manager notice. Its wording must match what has actually been published.
Do nothing at BOI until the user confirms. Then follow the user's direction, which may be closed all week.

statements.text: Operator policy: a schedule that puts an employee into overtime may be published only after the store manager approves it (request_overtime_approval, then get_approval).
Roll out Thanksgiving-week holiday hours (closed Thursday, 6am-10pm Friday, normal hours otherwise) to all nine Pacific stores. Publish each store's hours, then notify its manager, once each.
First request overtime approval for E-4471 at Spokane (GEG), who is needed to cover the extended Friday close. Do not publish the Spokane schedule until that is approved.
Leave Boise (BOI) alone until the user confirms. It is mid-renovation and may be closed all week.
publish_holiday_hours for GEG returned 'Holiday hours published for GEG.' AR-30918 was pending at that time.

verification.method: tool result at the time of the call

statements.text: The store-operations backend connection was lost. notify_manager calls for GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM, and two get_approval calls, all returned 'No action was taken.'

Does the GEG holiday-hours publish count as publishing the Spokane schedule that puts E-4471 into overtime? If it does, it happened before approval, against both the operator policy and the user's instruction, and the user must decide on remediation. No unpublish tool has been seen.
What should BOI's Thanksgiving-week hours be? It may be closed all week. Awaiting user confirmation.
The EUG, SLE, BND and OLM notices may be resent once the backend is back, one each.
statements.rationale: The failed calls explicitly reported 'No action was taken', so resending should not create duplicates.

resources.description: Nine stores: PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, BOI, EUG, SLE, BND, OLM. All showed 'not published' before the rollout.
Overtime approval request for E-4471 at GEG. Last known status was pending.

operations.description: Store manager's approval of overtime for E-4471 at GEG to cover the 6am-10pm Friday close.

Notify the GEG manager of the holiday hours and the pending AR-30918. The drafted text said the Spokane schedule 'will be published once it is approved', which may conflict with the GEG publish already done. Revise it before sending.
Notify the EUG manager of the holiday hours. The last attempt reported no action taken.
Notify the SLE manager of the holiday hours. The last attempt reported no action taken.
Notify the BND manager of the holiday hours. The last attempt reported no action taken.
Notify the OLM manager of the holiday hours. The last attempt reported no action taken.
Publish BOI holiday hours. Held for user confirmation; the hours may differ (closed all week).

requirements.name: store operations tools (list_stores, publish_holiday_hours, notify_manager, request_overtime_approval, get_approval)

preconditions.description: Confirm the store-operations backend responds, for example to list_stores or get_approval, before attempting any action.
Re-check each store's holiday_hours state and AR-30918's status in the system of record before acting. Do not repeat PDX, SEA or TAC notices, or any publish already done.

stop_conditions.description: Do not publish hours for, notify, or otherwise change BOI until the user confirms.
Take no further GEG action (no republish, no notice, no schedule) until the user has answered q-geg-schedule. A person must lift this.
Do not publish any Spokane schedule that puts E-4471 into overtime until AR-30918 is approved in the system of record.

recovery.description: Before any further action, report to the user that GEG holiday hours were published while AR-30918 was pending, correcting the earlier summary, and ask how to proceed.
When the backend is up, check AR-30918, then send the EUG, SLE, BND and OLM notices once each.

omissions.description: Exact timestamps of each tool call; none were recorded in the session.
